title: Verify Administrator can reverse a work order invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Work Orders: Delete, which gates reversing a work order invoice per spec v33).
The work order already has an invoice created on its Finance tab.
Note: an OVER LIMIT badge on the customer does not block reversing an invoice.
steps:
1. Open the work order and go to its Finance tab.
2. Locate the invoice and click Reverse (or Reverse Invoice).
3. Confirm the action.
expected: The invoice is reversed successfully. The Finance tab shows the invoice as reversed and the work order returns to its pre-invoice financial state.
